notes: Source: Alphabet Inc. 10-Q filed April 30, 2026, accession 0001652044-26-000048, for quarter ended March 31, 2026 (Q1 FY2026).
Alphabet reports in millions USD; all values multiplied by 1,000,000 for full dollar amounts.
Revenue and net income from Consolidated Statements of Income (three months ended March 31, 2026).
Total assets from Consolidated Balance Sheet as of March 31, 2026.

Capital expenditures are 'Purchases of property and equipment' (presented as positive outflow).
Net income of $62.6B includes a ~$36.8B non-cash gain on debt and equity securities in Other income (expense), net.
